reason: The pay-only-after-the-job-is-done part is exactly what I'd ask anyway, so it got my attention. But for this kind of thing I go by who my neighbours vouch for, not an app, so I'd only try it once on something small to see if it actually works the way it says.
objection: What if the freelancer disputes it and the refund takes forever, and the ratings near me are still thin -- a handful of completed jobs isn't really proof yet.
would_change_my_mind: If someone in my own WhatsApp group had actually used it and said the refund worked without a fight.
